evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim rendering a technical reliability claim in plain matched-clause form — the document's register signature crystallized in one utterance.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the rule here entering as a matched opposition of clauses that makes the technical claim memorable and binding, rather than as a flat statement?
